samplingNote: Timestamps and zone assignments are simulated for development. Rows are independently generated scenarios, not a physically continuous plant recording.

labelDefinitions.fault_class: Synthetic fault mode assigned by the scenario generator.
labelDefinitions.is_anomaly: 1 for any generated non-NORMAL fault scenario; 0 for NORMAL.
labelDefinitions.hazard_event_within_10m: Rule-generated binary label from a synthetic compound hazard score with bounded noise; not an observed real-world event.

limitations: Not real sensor telemetry and not field validated.
Labels are generated from the same simulation rules used to produce the sensor patterns; model metrics can overstate real-world generalization.
Do not use as the sole basis for safety decisions or production model acceptance.
